nodes.label: DESIGN.app.md — Cosmos Authenticated UI Design System
accent #5e6ad2 (Linear lavender)
nodes.rationale: Single accent for CTAs, active links, focus — not for decoration. Enterprise density approach avoids marketing fluff

nodes.label: Enterprise density principle
nodes.rationale: Tables, kanbans and forms must be readable without marketing fluff; opposed to canvas marketing #010102 used on website

nodes.label: Marketing canvas #010102 near-pure black
nodes.rationale: Deepest dark surface — faint blue tint intentional, not true #000000. Four-step surface ladder provides hierarchy without shadows

nodes.label: Linear lavender-blue #5e6ad2 brand accent
nodes.rationale: Used only on brand mark, focus rings, primary CTA — never decoratively. Scarce usage creates intentional brand clarity

nodes.label: C1 — Remove Liveblocks wildcard grant (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: Active cross-tenant breach — any user can read/write any tenant Liveblocks rooms via wildcard session.allow('*')

nodes.label: C2 — Encrypt third-party credentials at rest (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: Integration credentials (Jira, Azure, GitHub, Trello, Slack) stored unencrypted; requires AES-256-GCM via ENCRYPTION_KEY

nodes.label: C6 — Fix RLS policies + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: 4 broken policies reference non-existent tenantId columns; INSERT policies missing WITH CHECK clause; FORCE RLS needed

nodes.label: next-forge Philosophy (Fast/Cheap/Opinionated/Modern/Safe)
nodes.rationale: Five core principles: Fast (quick to ship), Cheap (free to start), Opinionated (integrated tooling), Modern (latest stable), Safe (end-to-end type safety + security)
